body.x: The announcement and launch of this brilliant new skins product is scheduled for Day One of CES 2013 on January 8, 2013. Not since Justin Bieber have we heard this many millions of tween, teen and young adult females scream. What are these “Directioners” screaming at the top of their lungs for? Skins for their smartphones, laptops, tablets and mp3 players!

Zing Revolution, A MusicSkins, LLC brand announces at CES 2013 their exclusive line of One Direction vinyl skins for Consumer Electronic Devices, credit card skins and more, available ONLY from Z!NG Revolution a MusicSkins, LLC brand.

While many at CES are obsessing over 100s of different hard case offerings, only Zing Revolution offers collectable vinyl skins of the biggest pop band in the world for the millions and millions of 1D fans.
One Direction vinyl skins are central for Zing Revolution’s retail penetration strategy.

“The centerpiece of our efforts is leveraging our license with Global for One Direction and bringing vinyl skins to 100’s of thousands of retail doors worldwide in 2013. CES is our Launch Pad to mass retail both online and brick and mortar. The vinyl skin industry is still very early stage with over 95 percent market penetration available. Zing Revolution is the first to really penetrate mass retail especially brick and mortar but also online wholesale print on demand drop ship. We never expected this fast a response from retail and it is great to be offering “the Next Big Thing”. ” explains ZING’s head of sales Lou Lamphear who is leading the launch at CES 2013.

Zing just launched phase one of its new brand Zing Revolution including a new Magento website www.zingrevolution.com built by Magento Gold partner New York based CorraTech. The next phase scheduled for February 2013 includes a B2B online system to make retail ordering easy, curated collections offered as microsites for great brands such as the Smithsonian Institute, Coca Cola, the amazing photographer Wayne Rutledge and of course an expanded collection of One Direction photographs and graphics from the official style guide provided by 1D’s master licensor Global Merchandise Services.Z!NG Revolution’s One Direction skins include individual images of each band member- Harry Styles, Zayn Malik, Liam Payne, Niall Horan and Louis Tomlinson- and special group shots of the boys which assures different retailers can sell exclusive images from the Zing collection.

The first to offer an exclusive Zing Revolution 1D image is the mega retailer Claires North America which is rolling out the 1D phone-booth image for IPhone skins on January 8th to coincide with the first day of CES 2013.

“We have plenty of images and designs to assure all key retailers can sell a “one of a kind exclusive image” of this history making pop sensation. After seeing the boys live at their sold out show at Madison Square Garden in December 2012, I am a true Directioner. They really sing, they are sincere and humble and being part of this merchandise movement is a chance in a life time.” smiles Zing Revolution’s managing partner Lara Lavi.
